"''Seven-Five-Seven here. Copy.|An [[officer]] and Ezra Bridger, disguised as LS-757|}} LS-757 was an [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[stormtrooper]] who was assigned to guard a hatch in [[Sector 5-1-5]] on the [[planet]] [[Lothal]]. During an [[Attack on Lothal|attack]] on the planet, LS-757 went to apprehend [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel Alliance]] [[pilot]] [[Mart Mattin]], but was choked unconscious by Mattin. Later, LS-757 was stationed aboard the ''[[Chimaera]]'' before it was pulled through [[hyperspace]] to the planet [[Peridea]] by [[purrgil]]. [[File:LS757shot-JWW.png|thumb|300px|left|LS-757 was shot by Sabine Wren while attempting to kill Ezra Bridger.]] In [[9 ABY]], [[Ahsoka Tano]], [[Ezra Bridger]] and [[Sabine Wren]] tried to [[battle of Peridea|escape]] from Peridea on the ''Chimaera'' before it jumped into hyperspace. LS-757 stood in the hangar bay alongside another [[Night Trooper]]. As the ship departed, Bridger and Wren both used a [[The Force|force]] trick which allowed Bridger to get onto the ship. As Bridger [[Death|killed]] the other Night Trooper, LS-757 tried to fire at Bridger, but was gunned down by Wren. {{Char-stub}} ==Appearances== {{Indexpage}} *{{Rebels|Rebel Assault}} {{1st}} *{{Ahsoka|Part Eight: The Jedi, the Witch, and the Warlord}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |es=LS-757 |ja=LS-757 |ka=LS-757 |nl=LS-757 }} [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Lothal Imperial Garrison members]] [[Category:Males]] [[Category:Personnel of Thrawn's forces]] [[Category:Stormtroopers of Imperial remnants]] [[Category:Stormtroopers of the Galactic Empire]]
